name: Rheingold
source:
When the young Dragon Prince Herbert receives a magic lamp, he encounters the djinni Aqila and makes a wish that will change his life—and the fate of his entire kingdom—forever.

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/rheingold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当年轻的龙王子赫伯特收到一盏神灯时，他遇到了神灵阿其拉，并许下了一个将永远改变他的生活以及整个王国命运的愿望。

[来自[url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/rheingold]Itch.io[/url]]
